units.text: INT. DECOMMISSIONED GRAIN ELEVATOR - NIGHT
A concrete cathedral of silos, six stories of rust and pigeon-dung, stairwells winding upward like the inside of a seashell.
Moonlight falls through a broken roof panel and lays a cold coin on the floor.
DETECTIVE IMOGEN KARLSSON-OYELARAN (40s, rain-colored coat, a limp she disguises as a stride) climbs the catwalk with a flashlight held low.
Her breath fogs.
Below, in the shadow of Silo Three, MAXIMILIAN "MAXI" BRZEZINSKI (30s, bookish, a scholar's stoop, hands trembling around a duffel bag) watches her ascend.
A radio crackles on her belt.
Karlsson, backup is eleven minutes out.
units.name: DISPATCHER

units.text: Eleven's too long.
units.name: IMOGEN

units.text: Say again?
units.name: DISPATCHER

units.text: She switches the radio off.
Above her, a boot scrapes iron.

On the upper gantry, RAFFERTY DUNNE (50s, heavy, a gold tooth that catches the moon) and his niece, SOLENNE DUNNE (20s, shaved head, a ledger tucked under one arm) lean over the rail, perfectly still.
Far across the chamber, ABEBE TSEGAYE (60s, retired elevator operator, a ring of keys at his belt) stands at the old control panel, one hand on a lever.
Everyone stays where they are.
units.name: ABEBE

units.text: Detective, you're early.
units.name: RAFFERTY

units.text: Mr. Dunne, put the ledger down.
units.name: IMOGEN

units.text: It's not his ledger.
units.name: SOLENNE

units.text: It's not her ledger.
units.name: RAFFERTY

units.text: It's mine!
units.name: MAXI

units.text: The echo carries the word up through six stories of concrete and back down again, thinner each time.
Abebe's hand tightens on the lever.
Somewhere beneath the floor, a conveyor chain groans awake.
